extracted.name: Baking Powder Biscuits (Harper Compact All-Temp Oven Cooking Guide)
extracted.description: Great recipe for Baking Powder Biscuits (Harper Compact All-Temp Oven Cooking Guide).
instruction_lines: Sift flour twice with baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening quickly until coarse in appearance.
Gradually add milk, mixing lightly to a smooth, soft dough.
Turn onto a slightly floured board and pat or roll 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick.
Cut with floured cutter and place close together on an ungreased baking sheet.
